description: Byte budgets (gzip) and timing targets from blueprint 8.1, 8.2, and 4.2. Enforced by scripts/check/budgets.mjs from each page's critical set and by Playwright network logs and marks. Owner: lane L0; values change only by a reviewed edit.

jsStaticGraph.note: a page's static import graph; maps and players are dynamic imports

fontsPreloaded.note: League Spartan variable latin and Roboto 400 latin

stormAlertIndexAlarm.note: storm-day alerts.json measured separately; alarm, not failure

mapInteractive.note: MapLibre GL JS 6.12.0 JS and CSS (about 315 KB) plus map/* plus tiles in view, outlines, headquarters points, and the Nation detail file or the overview; never before alerts-painted and a map request; check:budgets fails when the vendored set grows past 330 KB

mapOutline.note: topojson-client plus outlines.topo.json and files already fetched; no tiles and no third-party request

imageWithoutTap.note: the 300 px GOES still and WPC images qualify

requestWithoutTap.note: asserted on every page by Playwright

serviceWorkerPrecache.note: vendor/maplibre-gl-* and map/* are never precached
